headline: Brazilian Markets Focus on Copom Interest Rate Decision and US Payrolls
summary: Brazilian investors face a shortened trading week centered on the central bank's Copom interest rate announcement on Wednesday and US nonfarm payrolls report on Friday.
why: Copom sets Brazil's benchmark Selic rate, influencing domestic borrowing costs, currency valuations, and local equities.

impacts.name: Brazilian Selic Rate
impacts.why: The upcoming central bank policy decision determines the benchmark borrowing rate in Brazil.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
